lead_raw_text:
The structure of Fe2Ge2As2Sb2 (FeGeAsSb) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Pnma (No. 143), with eight atoms per unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows As and Fe each adopt tetrahedral coordination, with As surrounded by two Fe and two Sb neighbors, while Fe is coordinated by two As and two Ge neighbors. Sb and Ge each have three geometric neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between As and Fe tetrahedra and between Fe and Ge polyhedra, with the neighbor graph forming a single three-dimensional component.
